# ui::testing::TestNotifier

Header: `winui/testing/TestNotifier.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::Notifier`.

[Notifier](../tree/notifier.md) test double: shows nothing, keeps every notification it was handed, and clicks one on request.

Install it with [set_notifier()](namespace-ui-testing.md#set_notifier); [ui::notify()](../tree/namespace-ui.md#notify) then reaches it. It uninstalls itself when destroyed.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::testing::TestNotifier notifier;
ui::testing::set_notifier(&notifier);
bool opened = false;

ui::notify({.title = "Export finished", .on_click = [&] { opened = true; }});
REQUIRE(notifier.shown.size() == 1);
REQUIRE(notifier.shown[0].title == "Export finished");
notifier.click(0);
REQUIRE(opened);
```
